NONE: › abbreviation for business-to-consumer: describing or involving the sale of goods or services directly to customers for their own use, rather than to businesses
企業對消費者的（指產品銷售或服務是直接對消費者，而非對企業的銷售方式，business-to-consumer的縮寫）

example: We would not rule out the possibility of re-entering the B2C market if conditions change.
如果情況有變，我們不排除重新進軍B2C市場的可能性。
